summary:
Revised Implementation Plan for Category 11 (Real Estate & Property Management in Algeria):
1. UI Alignment: Strictly locked to Atrium's existing design system—AtriumButton (#C4785A terracotta), #F8F9FA elevated pod trays, #1F1D1B Dark Espresso anchors, UniversalDataCollection (List/Grid/Drawer), Seek expanding search, and kinetic LabelInput/LabelSelect. Zero new UI concepts or third-party design systems introduced.
2. Unified Navigation (No Role UI Separation): Eradicated role-based workspace fragmentation. All tools—Mandate Register, Property Passport, Leases & Arrears, Field Visits, Inspections, and Notary Finance—are accessible directly in a unified single-workspace agency cockpit.
3. Retains 100% of authentic Algerian compliance: Décret exécutif 09-18 (Mandates), Article 317 Code du Timbre (Quittance stamp duty), Décret 08-243 (Notary fee & tax schedule), and Touchscreen Bon de Visite with GPS.
